exceptions.reason: Prototype poisoning of mergeObject()'s result. deepmerge 4.3.1 is the latest release and every one from 4.2.0 is affected. It reaches the app through @meridian/ui -> @react-email/components -> @react-email/render -> html-to-text 9.0.5, which merges only its own defaults with options the calling code sets: no request data reaches it. Low severity, below the moderate gate; kept here so the review is written down (ADR 0137).
